BI_GYEON.name: Soul in the Mirror (Bi-gyeon)
BI_GYEON.meaning: Reflection of the ego, signifying independence and equality.

GEOP_JAE.name: Celestial Challenger (Geop-jae)
GEOP_JAE.meaning: The trial of the ego and the flame of ambition.

SIK_SIN.name: Sacred Creator (Sik-sin)
SIK_SIN.meaning: Flow of natural expression and joy of abundance.

SANG_GWAN.name: Radiant Rebel (Sang-gwan)
SANG_GWAN.meaning: Spark of innovation that breaks old norms and births new worlds.

PYEON_JAE.name: Cosmic Adventurer (Pyeon-jae)
PYEON_JAE.meaning: Dance of destiny and risk, expanding the boundaries of wealth.

JEONG_JAE.name: Faithful Manager (Jeong-jae)
JEONG_JAE.meaning: Silent dignity of sincerity and preservation of stable essence.

PYEON_GWAN.name: Iron Warrior (Pyeon-gwan)
PYEON_GWAN.meaning: Weight of authority and power of transformation through self-discipline.

JEONG_GWAN.name: Noble Diplomat (Jeong-gwan)
JEONG_GWAN.meaning: Walking the path of honor and guarding the sacred order of society.

PYEON_IN.name: Solitary Mystic (Pyeon-in)
PYEON_IN.meaning: Whispers of intuition and the quest for extraordinary truth.

JEONG_IN.name: Eternal Sage (Jeong-in)
JEONG_IN.meaning: Merciful light of classic wisdom and mentorship.
